functional_sensitivity.kappa_blocked_reason: two independent reasons. (1) No LDA or hybrid spectra are in the pull — lda_campaign/ holds only scripts (make_opacity_lda.py, compare_point_full.py) and no spectral arrays. (2) The LDA documentation states that LDA absolute band intensities and kappa_R are floor-limited and are NOT quoted: the measured white floor is 0.6-2.6% of peak spectral density and only band positions and the libration region (40-60x floor) are quotable. Recomputing a mean from a floor-limited spectrum would produce a number that documentation itself declines to quote.
